source.title: Mnemonic coding of visual space in the monkey's dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

confidence_rationale: Canonical, replicated single-unit demonstration that dorsolateral PFC neurons hold a selective representation across an input-absent delay by sustained firing -- the existence proof for the rule/task-set-cell maintenance class ARC-063 instantiates. High source quality. Marked supports (not fork-deciding) because it establishes that maintenance of the CURRENTLY-RELEVANT item is carried by persistent delay activity; it does NOT speak to holding several differentiated, currently-unselected rules at once, which is the CRF's actual bottleneck. mapping_fidelity is moderate: the CRF needs a maintained POOL, this paper shows one engaged memorandum.
failure_signatures: Persistent delay-period firing is demonstrated for the single item currently held in memory (one cued location per trial); the paradigm does not require, and does not show, simultaneous sustained maintenance of multiple distinct task rules. Read literally it licenses sustained activity only for the engaged/selected rule, not for an available-but-unmatched pool.

Memory fields are spatially tuned and the delay activity is for an item that was just cued and will imminently be acted on -- i.e. the attended/selected item -- so it cannot be cited as evidence that an UNSELECTED rule must keep firing across long context-absent gaps.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Individual dorsolateral prefrontal neurons fire tonically and selectively during the delay period of an oculomotor delayed-response task, encoding the remembered location of a no-longer-present visual cue; the activity persists across the input-absent delay and predicts the upcoming response.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the existence proof for ARC-063's rule/task-set-cell class: PFC maintains a behaviourally-relevant latent representation across an epoch in which its driving input is absent. It maps to the CRF's requirement that a minted rule remain 'available' between the moments its context recurs. For the CRF's CURRENTLY-MATCHED-AND-SELECTED rule, Funahashi licenses a sustained-activity (recurrent) maintenance term -- fork A.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paradigm maintains ONE engaged item per trial. The CRF's failure (V3-EXQ-666) is not maintaining the engaged rule but holding a POOL of >=2 differentiated rules that each match only a sparse slice of contexts and are mostly unselected at any tick. Funahashi does not show that an unselected, sparsely-matching rule keeps firing across the long gaps between its matches -- so it supports fork A for the engaged rule only, not as the mechanism for pool availability.
mapping.source_context: Awake behaving macaque; single-unit recording in dorsolateral PFC (principal sulcus); oculomotor delayed-response task with 1-6 s delays.

confidence_components.notes: Foundational primate electrophysiology, extensively replicated -- source_quality near ceiling. mapping_fidelity discounted because the single-engaged-item paradigm is a partial match to the CRF's multi-rule-pool maintenance problem. transfer_risk moderate: macaque PFC -> a discrete software rule-field is a mechanism-class transfer, not a parameter transfer.
